The outlined treatment plan for acute bacterial sinusitis is appropriate. The use of amoxicillin-clavulanate for 10 days is a standard first-line antibiotic therapy for acute bacterial sinusitis. Nasal saline irrigation helps clear mucus and reduce inflammation, while oral decongestants provide symptomatic relief. The advice to return for evaluation if symptoms persist beyond seven days or worsen is consistent with clinical guidelines, as it allows for monitoring of treatment efficacy and early detection of complications or alternative diagnoses.
